reasoning_content: Installation succeeded. Next, run the toolchain integrity check that's mentioned in the guide (`pnpm check:toolchain-consistency`). This is the official check (for studio, it's a prerequisite before runtime debugging, but it's also good as a general toolchain verification).

action.command: cd /workspace && timeout 300 pnpm check:toolchain-consistency 2>&1 | tail -25; echo "EXIT: $?"
